mapper.sql: select r.id, r.user_id, r.file_id, r.title, r.stance, r.contract_text, r.status, r.risk_level, r.summary, r.risks_json, r.model_name, r.error_msg, r.create_time, r.update_time from law_contract_review r
mapper.update: update law_contract_review set status = #{status}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, summary = #{summary}, risks_json = #{risksJson}, model_name = #{modelName}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 'pending'
mapper.delete: delete from law_contract_review where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from law_contract_review where file_id = #{fileId}
